_doc: FB-022: the announcer is the voice of the dungeon itself: ancient, smug, a little bored, and deeply unimpressed by you. Dark and goofy; no show, audience, sponsors or achievements.

floor_enter.title: THE DUNGEON GREETS YOU — FLOOR {floor}
floor_enter.body: You have 5 days to find a stairwell before the ceiling becomes your new hat. No peeking at what's below. Good luck, snack.

floor_enter.title: FLOOR {floor}. OH, IT'S YOU AGAIN.
floor_enter.body: The stones remember your footsteps. They were not impressed. Try not to trip over a draugr in the first five minutes.

safe_room_discovered.title: A SANCTUARY. HOW DISAPPOINTING.
safe_room_discovered.body: Monsters cannot follow you in here — an ancient ward older than spite. Trade with the merchant, read the wall map, catch your breath.

boss_arena_sealed.title: THE GATE SLAMS SHUT
boss_arena_sealed.body: Two creatures enter. One of them gets the key to the Treasure Vault. The dungeon has placed a small wager. Not on you.

boss_defeated.title: THE WARDEN FALLS. THE DUNGEON SULKS.
boss_defeated.body: The Treasure Vault seal has lifted. Collect your loot before the floor collapses and pretend it wasn't luck.

legendary_loot.title: SOMETHING OLD AND ANGRY FOUND YOU
legendary_loot.body: A legendary relic has chosen you: {item_name}. The dungeon would like it back. Eventually. With interest.

floor_collapse.title: THE FLOOR COLLAPSES! TIME'S UP!
floor_collapse.body: Five days passed and you're still here. The dungeon rewinds you to the start of the floor. Maybe walk faster next time?

player_death.title: YOU DIED. THE DUNGEON GIGGLES.
player_death.body: Death down here is more of a suggestion. The dark spits you back out at the start of the floor, slightly embarrassed.

level_up.title: LEVEL UP — LEVEL {level}!
level_up.body: Slightly harder to squish! Spend your Skill/Attribute bonuses in your Character Menu [Tab / I].

time_warning.title: COLLAPSE WARNING — {days_left} DAYS REMAINING
time_warning.body: Reminder: the stone ceiling is scheduled to meet the stone floor. Find a hidden stairwell.

first_kill.title: FIRST BLOOD!
first_kill.body: You applied sharp metal to a hostile resident. The other residents are taking notes.
